product_updates.title: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry
product_updates.content: National outcry against data center construction has spread to Philadelphia, where officials suggested possible construction in a neighborhood already impacted by a now-defunct oil refinery.

product_updates.title: Meta now lets AI agents handle the boring parts of WhatsApp Business setup
product_updates.content: A new WhatsApp Business MCP server lets developers use AI coding agents like Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT to handle setup, messaging templates, testing, and troubleshooting.

product_updates.title: US data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035
product_updates.content: The AI frenzy could push U.S. data centers to become one of the largest consumers of natural gas in the world.

product_updates.title: AI agents now have a place to snitch
product_updates.content: The AI Contact Hotline is designed to be a discreet place where agents that have witnessed misbehavior can tip off authorities.

product_updates.title: Meta expands subscription push with new AI-focused plans
product_updates.content: Meta One bundles expanded access to the company’s AI tools with premium features across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

product_updates.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google have been in talks on AI safety for weeks
product_updates.content: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, as Trump's team dismisses safety concerns and pushes to keep pace with China.

product_updates.title: AEO startup Profound hits unicorn valuation, raises $180M Series D 7 months after last round
product_updates.content: Profound has raised a $180 million Series D at a $1.8 billion valuation, less than seven months after it raised a $96 million Series C.

product_updates.title: Former TikTok execs built an app that uses AI to teach you how to pose for a photo
product_updates.content: Essentially a camera app, Superpose analyzes selfies or photos and generates four potential poses using AI.
